recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not duplicate the current ElementDefinition prose or change Resource.id away from System.String for this issue; any future work on generated inherited snapshots or FHIRPath type-test behavior belongs under later dedicated trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-25274 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I change request raised against R4 and applied for R5. It reported that Resource.id had a structuredefinition-fhir-type value of string rather than id and asked for documentation explaining FHIRPath System.String and the structuredefinition-fhir-type extension.
initial_application: The Resource.id type correction was handled by the closely related FHIR-25262 work and current source history leaves Resource.id at fhir-type valueUrl id. The FHIR-25274 documentation request was explicitly applied by commit a60a9ee277bbd8c4b2be9b0686c37f0bdfe6bf37, which added ElementDefinition notes for FHIRPath simple types and the fhir-type extension.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Resource in the active infrastructure build scope and maps the ElementDefinition narrative page. The linked 2019 Zulip discussion and FHIR-I minutes support the intended model: Resource.id is represented in StructureDefinitions as FHIRPath System.String without primitive child elements, while structuredefinition-fhir-type value id carries the FHIR id value constraints.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/resource/structuredefinition-Resource.xml already has Resource.id with code http://hl7.org/fhirpath/System.String and structuredefinition-fhir-type valueUrl id, and source/elementdefinition.html already contains the requested explanatory notes.
